title: When discipline keeps thinning out after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: Good intention is present, but the pattern cannot hold. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru places discipline inside remembrance, restraint, and inner victory instead of image management. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: The hardest field is the inner field. Win there first. Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer.
actionPrompt: Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
